c120a7098f: The shell's own interface — its colors, its glass, its motion, its type, its marks and its sounds — packaged as a library, so an application can be built out of the same material and sit beside it.
8bdc6bffb4: The four applications above are built on it. lxb-new my-player gives you a buildable Wayland application in Rust, C or Python: one function saying what is on the page, driven by a keyboard, a pointer and every controller on the machine, and not one line naming a color, a radius or a duration. Toolkit applications are ordinary Wayland programs, so they run under GNOME or Plasma as readily as under LineXinBar.
